cleanupIncident: Cleanup returned PRIVATE_IMAGE_STORAGE_FAILED/503 on the initial call for attempt2 and final run; each bounded retry succeeded. The harness instantiated private backend with a 20-second AbortSignal before waiting the 60-second deletion grace. A separate mock-transport reproduction confirmed that expired lifetime maps to this error and a fresh backend succeeds; cleanup generator now instantiates the backend after waiting. This is not evidence of a hosted Storage outage.
